prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='FT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: Analysis reveals THETA as trend champion (avg_trend_corr=1.0) and FT_rf as seasonality champion (avg_seasonal_corr=0.9608), while ONLY_DWT_rf dominates overall RMSE (78.64) and both horizon segments. High model disagreement (rmse_spread_ratio=46.14) and concept drift detected suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition structure while handling variance. The wavelet/transform models (DWT_rf, CWT_rf, FT_catboost) form a strong tier1 ensemble with complementary pattern capture.
